Jurassic Park - Rampage Edition.name: Jurassic Park: Rampage Edition
Jurassic Park - Rampage Edition.summary: Jurassic Park: Rampage Edition is a side-scroller released in 1994 by Sega for the Sega Mega Drive System and for its American equivalent, the Sega Genesis. It is the sequel to the popular game Jurassic Park.
